# Fixture world for _ctl/tests/resolve-upstream.test.sh — the upstream table of
# a miniature repository, 1 row per datasource.
#
# Nothing resolves these rows in anger. The test copies this tree to a temporary
# directory, points UPSTREAM_PROJECT_ROOT at the copy and puts a stub `curl`
# first on PATH, so each row below drives 1 datasource function of
# _build/resolve-upstream.sh against a document this repository holds.
#
# The grammar is the real one, 4 fields, none empty:
#
#   <pin>|<datasource>|<coordinate>|<policy or reason>
#
# The 3 github-release rows at the top are 3 different questions: a pin whose
# value carries no `v`, a pin whose value carries one (gophersys/cictl pins
# `v0.1.0`), and a pin that is already at the newest release and must therefore
# produce no bump.
#
# The 3 github-release rows at the foot ask a 4th question, and it is about the
# ASSET rather than the version: how many digests does 1 pin answer for. Their
# governed file is cloud/Dockerfile — 2 case arms, 2 case arms fetched twice,
# and no case arm at all.

STUBGITHUB_VERSION|github-release|stubowner/stubgithub|bump to the newest non-prerelease tag
STUBVPREFIX_VERSION|github-release|stubowner/stubvprefix|bump to the newest non-prerelease tag
STUBCURRENT_VERSION|github-release|stubowner/stubcurrent|bump to the newest non-prerelease tag
STUBPYPI_VERSION|pypi|stub-pypi-package|bump to the newest release on the index
STUBNPM_VERSION|npm|stub-npm-package|bump to the dist-tag latest
STUBAPT_VERSION|apt|stub-apt-package|bump to the newest published binary of the ubuntu series
STUBGO_VERSION|go-dl|go|bump to the newest stable release
STUBNODE_VERSION|node-dist|lts|bump to the newest LTS release
STUBOCI_REF|oci-index|library/ubuntu:24.04|bump to the digest the tag holds now
STUBK8S_VERSION|k8s-dl|stable|bump to the newest stable release
STUBTAILSCALE_VERSION|tailscale-pkgs|stable|bump to the newest stable package
STUBFLUTTER_VERSION|flutter-releases|stable|bump to the newest release of the stable channel
STUBEDEN_VERSION|eden-manifest|gophersys/eden:harnesses/versions.env|mirror the value eden pins, which is the one decision point for a harness version
STUBDUAL_VERSION|github-release|stubowner/stubdual|bump to the newest non-prerelease tag, and to 1 digest per case arm
STUBSHARED_VERSION|github-release|stubowner/stubshared|bump to the newest non-prerelease tag; 2 governed files fetch this one at 1 url
STUBNOARCH_VERSION|github-release|stubowner/stubnoarch|bump to the newest non-prerelease tag; 1 asset serves every platform
STUBFROZEN_VERSION|no-autobump|none|the fixture world needs a row that resolves nothing, so the dry run can be watched leaving it alone
